## Classes

### RuleEngine

**Deprecated.**

RuleEngine evaluates per-layout client rules against a form binding. Owns the dependency graph, topological order, cycle detection, and the actual evaluation loop. The host component drives it with form events (onLoad / onFieldChange / onFieldBlur / onBeforeSave).

```ts
class RuleEngine {
    constructor(opts: RuleEngineOptions);
    getDiagnostics(): RuleEngineDiagnostic[];
    isDisabled(): boolean;
    isComputed(field: string): boolean;
    onLoad(form: FormBinding): void;
    onFieldChange(field: string, form: FormBinding): void;
    onFieldBlur(field: string, form: FormBinding): void;
    runBeforeSave(form: FormBinding): BeforeSaveResult;
}
```

### MessageComposer

Message input (telehealth slice 3): Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a newline. Clears only after a successful onSend so failed sends keep the draft; a failed promise surfaces the error state to the caller (toast).

```ts
function MessageComposer({ onSend, disabled, placeholder, sendLabel, className, testId, }: MessageComposerProps): JSX.Element;
```

### MessageList

Reverse-chronology-safe message stream (telehealth slice 3): renders the given messages oldest→newest, right-aligns the current user's, centers SYSTEM notices, and keeps the viewport pinned to the newest message when it was already at (or near) the bottom.

```ts
function MessageList({ messages, currentUserId, emptyText, senderLabel, className, testId, }: MessageListProps): JSX.Element;
```

## Type aliases

### ChatSenderType

Chat primitives (telehealth slice 3) — purely presentational, fed by the consuming app's hooks. No KeltaClient coupling so the same components serve the staff console and the portal page-builder widget.

```ts

```
